titel: Summer Bonus: The Adventure of the Noble Bachelor

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts; Ausschnitte dieser Sendung waren in zwei Messungen mit Stunden Abstand stumm - die Datei wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt

einzeiler: Sherlock Holmes investigates the bizarre disappearance of a noble bride on her wedding…
kurzfassung: Sherlock Holmes is asked to investigate the baffling disappearance of a newlywed bride who vanished during her wedding breakfast. Through careful deduction and a clue found on a discarded hotel bill, Holmes tracks down the missing woman. The mystery resolves when it is revealed that her first husband, long presumed dead after an Indian attack, has returned.
stichpunkte: Lord St. Simon consults Sherlock Holmes regarding the sudden disappearance of his bride, Hattie Doran, during their wedding breakfast.
Inspector Lestrade investigates the case, suspecting a jealous former dancer named Flora Miller of foul play.
Lestrade brings in waterlogged wedding clothes and a note found in the Serpentine as supposed evidence against Flora Miller.
Holmes examines a fragment of a hotel bill attached to the note and uses the high prices to identify the hotel where the American visitor stayed.
Holmes visits the couple at their lodgings and convinces them to meet with Lord St. Simon to clear up the misunderstanding.
The missing bride reveals that her first husband, Francis Hay Moulton, whom she believed was killed by Apache Indians, unexpectedly appeared at her wedding ceremony.

clips.hook: Lord Robert Walsingham DeVehrs and Simon
clips.text: Holmes reads the detailed noble lineage and background of his prospective client from a reference book.

clips.hook: My last client of the sort was a king
clips.text: Holmes casually mentions that the previous person who hired him for a similar delicate matter was the King of Scandinavia.

clips.hook: Every man's body is to be found in the neighborhood of his wardrobe
clips.text: Holmes sarcastically critiques the official detective's logic that finding discarded clothing implies the physical body must be nearby.

clips.hook: We met in a mining camp near the Rockies
clips.text: The returned husband explains how he and the bride originally met and fell in love during prospecting days in America.

clips.hook: By the select prices, eight shillings for a bed
clips.text: Holmes explains how specific luxury hotel charges on a bill fragment allowed him to pinpoint exactly where the American visitor was staying.

beschreibung:
Sherlock Holmes may not be much of a lover himself, but when it comes to mysteries associated with romantic entanglements, he's often the only one who can unravel them. This week, he and Watson are approached by Lord St. Simon, a newlywed nobleman whose wife has disappeared without a trace mere hours after their wedding. While Lestrade searches for her body in the Thames, Holmes believes there is a simpler, and less deadly, explanation. As we wrap up our summer bonus series with a tale of marriage gone awry, let this latest story help you wrap up your day and fall into a night of warm and restful sleep.
